title: What are AI agents?
excerpt: Why AI is moving from answering questions to completing multi-step tasks.
body: An AI agent is a system designed to pursue a goal through multiple steps rather than only return a single response.
Agents can combine a model with tools such as search, databases, code execution and business applications. The model decides which action is useful and interprets the result.
Reliable agents need permissions, limits, observability and verification. Autonomy becomes useful only when organizations can understand and control what the system does.
